title: Critic protocol: a fresh read-only critic every ~3 passes, claims verified on the overlay
summary: A fresh read-only critic every ~3 passes gets the sheets + region numbers, returns a score and a top 10 with pixel locations and 3D fixes. Verify claims on the edge overlay; keep a ledger.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: brief: 'verify placement on the edges overlay before claiming it; give pixel locations and concrete 3D fixes'

gotchas: Critics are reliable on materials, light and poses, unreliable on hidden geometry: 2 of 5 final dig claims were wrong; 'the camera is off' was wrong on the café.
Rejected examples: 'remove the doubled post' (a back post), 'a cool key from back-right' (the lit end face disproves it), 'the hose is missing' (it was there).

problem.symptom: Passes wasted moving things that were already right or adding things that exist.
problem.cause: Critics hallucinate geometry and lighting directions from a single image.
problem.fix: Give critics the edge overlay + region numbers; require pixel locations; verify before acting; ledger.
